# InspireX Technologies Ltd

> InspireX is a Canadian IT consulting, cybersecurity and technology staffing
> firm based in Toronto, Ontario. It provides a full range of IT consulting and
> staffing services and solutions that enable clients to operate in a highly
> efficient, secure and effective manner, with custom-tailored solutions that
> fit each client's operational requirements.

## Company facts

- Legal name: InspireX Technologies Ltd
- Address: 100 King Street West – Suite 5700, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, M5X 1C7
- General enquiries: info@inspirex.ca
- Careers and applications: HR@inspirex.ca
- CAGE code: 87PLO
- California Certified Small Business: 2013947
- Operating principles: transparency, efficiency, quality execution, communication, versatility
- Senior consultants and principals have over 30 years of combined experience in
  IT security, risk management, IT consulting, advanced solutioning and
  regulatory compliance.

## Solutions

- [Cybersecurity](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/cybersecurity): Assessment, vulnerability management, incident response, penetration testing, governance and risk management, and compliance with NIST, CMMC, ISO 27001, 800-171 and PCI-DSS.
- [24/7 Infrastructure Monitoring](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/infrastructure-monitoring): Network monitoring, alerting on condition, availability and performance, and network performance tracking.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/disaster-recovery): Simplified backup and recovery of databases, servers, data files and applications, to minimize client downtime.
- [Data Management](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/data-management): Data storage and data management solutions that prevent lost files, virus infection and accidental deletion.
- [Software & Hardware Deployment](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/software-hardware-deployment): Custom deployment solutions developed to work within a client's constraints.
- [Project & Program Management](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/project-program-management): High-level program management to maximize the efficiency of IT management systems and techniques.
- [End-User Support](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/end-user-support): Break/fix, installation, moves, additions and changes, inventory and sanitization, SOPs, SLAs and end-user training.
- [Video Conferencing & Telephone Support](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/video-conferencing-telephony): VOIP and analog devices, call centre management tools, PBX support, unified messaging, circuit administration and video conferencing administration.
- [Application & Maintenance Support](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/application-maintenance-support): The AIEP approach — Assess, Implement, Evaluate, Protect — for keeping client applications current and secure.
- [SAP Managed Services](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/sap-managed-services): S/4HANA upgrade strategy, SAP optimization, SAP data archiving and SAP managed support including OpenText Vendor Invoice Management.
- [IT Staffing](https://www.inspirex.ca/solutions/it-staffing): Contract and direct-hire IT staffing matched to client hiring needs.
